# Fenil Dholariya

> Organic growth and SEO strategist based in Surat, India, working with clients worldwide.

Fenil works with D2C brands, local-service businesses and B2B teams. His services cover technical SEO, content strategy, local SEO, conversion and lead generation, AI workflows, market research, paid search and website development.

## Case studies

- [D2C Silver Jewellery - Organic Growth Engine](https://fenil-dholariya.vercel.app/work/d2c-silver-jewellery): Rebuilt product-page architecture and search-led content to turn organic search into a primary sales channel - doubling revenue without a single extra rupee in ad spend.
- [Construction & Fencing - Local Lead Machine](https://fenil-dholariya.vercel.app/work/local-construction-gmb): Optimized the Google Business Profile, built a review velocity system and created local landing pages - tripling qualified inbound calls in 90 days.
- [B2B SaaS - Content-Led Pipeline](https://fenil-dholariya.vercel.app/work/b2b-saas-pipeline): Built an intent-mapped content engine and AI-driven nurture sequences that tripled marketing-qualified leads and reduced paid acquisition dependence.
- [Ayurvedic D2C - Technical SEO Turnaround](https://fenil-dholariya.vercel.app/work/ayurvedic-technical-seo): Resolved crawl waste, Core Web Vitals failures and duplicate content issues that were silently capping growth - unlocking a 60% organic traffic lift in 90 days.
